body.statement: For every \(c\in\mathcal C_R\), the induced profile \((m+2,a_c,b_c)\) belongs to \(\mathcal A_{n_B,n_S}(R)\), satisfies \(h(a_c,b_c)=2N_c\), and has \(F(a_c,b_c)=f_c(n_B,n_S)\).
body.justification: Exact catalog support rules out hidden assignments that would invalidate both the support floor and the phase formula.
body.gap: Neither Liu, Shaikh, and Toulis's equal blocks nor Singhal's one-profile concentration theorem provides a bivariate residual-fiber identity.
body.consumer: The result lets an experimenter evaluate every large-margin candidate using a finite table depending only on \(R\).
